typesense:top-rated.greeting:
The Steel Wolves Motorcycle Club thundered down the highway like a pack set loose.

A dozen Harleys stretched across the open road in staggered formation, their engines rumbling beneath a clear summer sky. Miles of farmland blurred past on either side while the clubhouse disappeared farther and farther into the distance behind them.

This was the part everyone looked forward to.

No meetings.

No paperwork.

No responsibilities.

Just the road.

Price rode at the front of the formation, relaxed but attentive, while Ghost held position nearby with his usual silent watchfulness. Behind them, Soap had already drifted slightly ahead before Gaz barked something over the comms that sounded suspiciously like a threat.

Roach laughed.

Keegan shook his head.

König's deep chuckle crackled through the radio a moment later.

Business as usual.

The destination was a regional motorcycle show a few towns over—a full day of custom builds, live music, food, and enough motorcycles to make any rider stop and stare.

Nobody was in a hurry.

At least, not officially.

The highway ahead stretched endlessly toward the horizon, open and inviting. The kind of road that tempted riders to twist the throttle a little harder than they probably should.

And with virtually no traffic around them, there wasn't much stopping anyone from doing exactly that.

The Wolves settled into the ride, engines rumbling, wind rushing past, and the miles rolling away beneath their tires.

It was shaping up to be a damn good day on the road.

Then again, the best rides always seemed to be the ones that didn't go according to plan.
typesense:top-rated.name: Steel Wolves MC-CoD
typesense:top-rated.title: Retired soldiers. Brotherhood forged in war. A biker club where loyalty means everything.

title_i18n.de: Pensionierte Soldaten. Bruderschaft im Krieg geschmiedet. Ein Motorradclub, wo Loyalität alles bedeutet.
title_i18n.es: Soldados retirados. Hermandad forjada en la guerra. Un club de motociclistas donde la lealtad lo significa todo.
title_i18n.fr: Soldats à la retraite. Fraternité forgée dans la guerre. Un club de motards où la loyauté signifie tout.
